title: Freestanding Paper Towel Holder Stand - Carolina Collection - Solid Brass Countertop - 14.4-Inch Tall | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your countertop with a freestanding paper towel holder that stores a roll upright for space-saving convenience and stable, everyday use.

  • Freestanding design: No wall mounting required for flexible placement.
  • Solid brass construction: Crafted from the finest solid brass materials.
  • Stable base: Weighted base helps keep the stand steady as you tear sheets.
  • Surface protection: Felt pad helps prevent scratching on countertops.
  • Designer finishes: Built for corrosion-free, rust-free performance and available in 28 finish options, including statement colors.

Details & Specs

  • Collection: Carolina (traditional/classic styling for matching Carolina pieces)
  • Mounting type: Freestanding
  • Material: Brass
  • Overall dimensions: 6.5-Inch L x 6.5-Inch W x 14.4-Inch H (projection: 6.5-Inch)
  • Weight capacity: 5 lb
  • Product weight: 4 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Paper towel holder
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: Carolina Collection Counter Top Paper Towel Stand
_previous.description: Elegantly hold your paper towel roll on this classic traditional design paper towel stand. Its design is as functional as it is practical. The roll in the stand sits upright on the counter top allowing for space saving. It has a weight in the base to keep the unit stable as you tear off the sheets.
